notes.title: Exciting News for Fans of 'The Shore' A Lovecraftian Co-Op Game and More!
notes.notes:
Dear gamers and fans of "The Shore,"

 Today marks a special day as we celebrate the two-year anniversary since the release of "The Shore."
 We are extremely grateful for your continuous support and passion for our game. As a token of our 
 appreciation, we are excited to share some fantastic news with all of you.

As many of you are aware, we have been working on our next project, "Eresys," a Lovecraftian co-op game which will be released this April 6!!. We are delighted to inform you that the development of the game is well underway, and we cannot wait for you to experience it. We are confident that it will exceed your expectations and provide an unforgettable gaming experience.

Furthermore, we would like to share our future plans with you. We are thrilled to announce that following the release of "Eresys," we have two more games in the pipeline. The first is "Necrophosis," which promises to be a spine-chilling adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat. And last but not least, we are excited to reveal that "The Shore 2" is also in our future plans! with a chilling story line! and Unreal engine 5!!!

Once again, we would like to thank you for your unwavering support and loyalty to our games. We cannot wait to share these exciting projects with you and continue this journey together.

Sincerely,
[Ares Dragonis] and the development team.

Press "V" to view your screenshots in game

The Photo mode's interface can be hidden by pressing "H" if you prefer to take the screenshot using steam (default "F12")

notes.title: THE SHORE Crowdfunding campaign
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

We’re happy to announce The Shore’s crowdfunding campaign on Ulule!

Check it out here: https://www.ulule.com/the-shore-game/

If you want to support us, pick up a perk and get rewards like:

A special discount (up to 50% off) on The Shore at launch
Handcrafted 3D-printable models of giant creatures and statues from the game
Exclusive desktop wallpapers with scenes from the game
An opportunity to design a creature with the author of the game!

All of our backers will also get a “Thank you” mention in the credits

We have been working very hard to make our vision of a cosmic horror come to life. If this campaign succeeds, it will be of enormous importance for The Shore because it would enable us to hire more professionals to enrich it with their talents.

Until the next update,
Aris
